An unidentified '''Troig''' performed in a [[Circus/Legends|circus]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at some point during the regime of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The [[Troig/Legends|Troig]] artist performed [[Fire/Legends|fire]]-eating, an act that involved extinguishing a flame by suffocating it inside one's [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]].
